symptom: `exec` prints `Created workflow: M.X` on every re-run of a `create or modify workflow`, even when `mxcli diff` says nothing would be written
cause: `execCreateWorkflow` printed a fixed `Created workflow:` line for both the create and the in-place update branch, bypassing `ReportMutation`, so write elision never surfaced as `Unchanged`
insight: Every mutating handler must report through `ctx.ReportMutation` (Created/Modified, downgraded to Unchanged on elision); a hand-rolled Fprintf is what makes a no-op look like churn
